scope: Read-only partial diagnostic. Final case timing and parity remain pending.

maintenance_source.note: Late copy also includes the controller JSON outside this tree.

measurement_method: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; recursive file metadata enumeration of the two exact case roots; Get-Counter PhysicalDisk average write latency, current queue length, writes/sec and write bytes/sec, two samples one second apart. Values rounded to four decimal places.
limitations: Disk counters cover all activity on each disk, not just this coordinator. They cannot attribute latency to fsync, filesystem, device firmware, antivirus or competing I/O. File counts are partial progress snapshots.
source_observation: The frozen coordinator copies its controller and every maintenance file individually. cold_copy creates each E file, copies it, flushes and fsyncs it; the coordinator hashes each source and fully rereads each destination.
future_candidate: Bundle the identical late file inventory in a STORE ZIP, fsync the bundle, and verify exact E member inventory, sizes and SHA-256s. This is a proposed optimization, not an executed or validated speedup.
